_readme: Shot prompts for generated demo footage (pipeline/generate.mjs, Runway). Runway animates a generated still, so the prompt field composes the frame and the motion field describes what moves: framing is won or lost in the still. Every prompt must keep the face out of frame, because the faceless rule applies to generated footage exactly as it does to stock. Generation produces candidates only; full-motion editorial review is the only way into assets/demo-library.json.
look: Cinematic 35mm film look, fine natural grain, gentle highlight rolloff, warm neutral grade of bone white, oak and soft sage. True-to-life skin texture, no plastic retouching, no beauty filter. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
camera: Locked-off tripod, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field around f/2.8, subject sharp against a softly defocused room, no zoom and no whip pans.
light: One large north-facing window as the only key, soft directional daylight from frame left, deep natural shadow falloff, a warm practical lamp far in the background. No studio strobes, no coloured gels.
room: Plain modern apartment: bone-white walls, warm oak floor, one charcoal exercise mat, minimal furniture. No gym, no mirrors, no dumbbells, kettlebells, bands or machines of any kind.
wardrobe: An ordinary woman in her thirties, unstyled, in fitted charcoal leggings and a soft oatmeal tank, bare feet or plain unbranded trainers. No slogans or logos on clothing.
framing: Camera at chest height, framed from the collarbone down so the head is cropped out of the top of frame. No face, no profile, no reflection showing a face.

Wall Push-Up.prompt: Side-on medium shot of a woman standing at arm's length from a bone-white wall, palms planted flat at chest height, elbows softly bent, weight forward onto the balls of her feet, body in one straight line from heel to shoulder.
Wall Push-Up.motion: She bends her elbows to bring her chest toward the wall, holds for a beat, then presses smoothly back to straight arms. One controlled repetition, camera locked off.

Incline Push-Up.prompt: Side-on medium shot of a woman with both palms on the front edge of a low oak sofa, arms straight, feet walked back, body angled in one clean line from heel to shoulder.
Incline Push-Up.motion: She lowers her chest toward the sofa edge under control and presses back up to straight arms. One repetition, camera locked off.

Kneeling Push-Up.prompt: Low side-on shot from floor level of a woman on a charcoal mat, knees down and ankles crossed, palms under her shoulders, hips in line with her spine.
Kneeling Push-Up.framing: Camera resting at floor level looking along the mat, so the head passes out of frame beyond the top edge. No face at any point.
Kneeling Push-Up.motion: She lowers her chest toward the mat and presses back up. One slow repetition, camera stays low and static.

Full Push-Up.prompt: Low side-on shot from floor level of a woman holding a full push-up position on a charcoal mat, hands under her shoulders, body in one straight line from heel to shoulder.
Full Push-Up.framing: Camera resting at floor level looking along the mat, so the head passes out of frame beyond the top edge. No face at any point.
Full Push-Up.motion: She lowers her chest to a hand's width above the mat and presses back to straight arms. One controlled repetition, camera stays low and static.

Air Squat.prompt: Side-on medium shot of a woman standing on a warm oak floor, feet hip-width apart, arms reaching forward at shoulder height, weight settled through the mid-foot.
Air Squat.motion: She sits her hips back and down until her thighs are parallel to the floor, then drives through the floor to stand tall. One smooth repetition, camera locked off.

Wall Sit.prompt: Side-on medium shot of a woman with her back flat against a bone-white wall, knees bent to ninety degrees, shins vertical, hands resting lightly on her thighs.
Wall Sit.motion: She holds the position. Only the small rise and fall of breathing and a faint tremble in the thighs. Camera locked off.

Sit-to-Stand.prompt: Side-on medium shot of a woman seated on the front edge of a plain oak dining chair, arms folded across her chest, feet flat and set back beneath her knees.
Sit-to-Stand.motion: She leans forward, stands tall without using her hands, then lowers under control back to the seat. One repetition, camera locked off.

Reverse Lunge.prompt: Side-on medium shot of a woman standing tall on a warm oak floor, hands clasped at her chest, weight settled on the front foot.
Reverse Lunge.motion: She steps one foot back and lowers the back knee toward the floor, then drives through the front heel to stand tall again. One repetition, camera locked off.

Split Squat.prompt: Side-on medium shot of a woman in a split stance on a warm oak floor, front foot flat, back heel lifted, torso upright and tall.
Split Squat.motion: She lowers straight down until her back knee nearly touches the floor, then presses back up. One repetition, camera locked off.

Glute Bridge.prompt: Low side-on shot from floor level of a woman lying on a charcoal mat, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width, arms resting palms-down by her sides.
Glute Bridge.framing: Camera resting at floor level, level with her hips, so the head passes out of frame beyond the top edge. No face at any point.
Glute Bridge.motion: She drives her hips upward until knees, hips and shoulders form one line, holds a beat, then lowers with control. One slow repetition.

Hip Thrust.prompt: Low side-on shot of a woman with her upper back resting against the front edge of a low oak sofa, knees bent, feet flat on the floor, hips lowered toward the ground.
Hip Thrust.framing: Camera at floor level, level with her hips, so the head sits above the top edge of frame. No face at any point.
Hip Thrust.motion: She drives her hips up until they are level with her knees and shoulders, pauses, then lowers under control. One repetition.

Standing Hip Hinge.prompt: Side-on medium shot of a woman standing tall on a warm oak floor, hands flat on the front of her thighs, knees softly bent, spine long and neutral.
Standing Hip Hinge.motion: She pushes her hips back, sliding her hands down her thighs while her back stays flat, then returns to standing tall. One slow repetition, camera locked off.

Full Plank.prompt: Low side-on shot from floor level of a woman on a charcoal mat in a forearm plank, elbows stacked under her shoulders, body in one straight line from heel to shoulder.
Full Plank.framing: Camera resting at floor level looking along the mat, so the head passes out of frame beyond the top edge. No face at any point.
Full Plank.motion: She holds the plank. Only breathing moves. Camera stays low and static.

Knee Plank.prompt: Low side-on shot from floor level of a woman in a forearm plank from her knees on a charcoal mat, elbows under her shoulders, hips level with her spine.
Knee Plank.framing: Camera resting at floor level looking along the mat, so the head passes out of frame beyond the top edge. No face at any point.
Knee Plank.motion: She holds the position steadily. Only breathing moves. Camera stays low and static.

Side Plank.prompt: Low shot of a woman on a charcoal mat in a side plank on one forearm, hips lifted and stacked, top arm resting along her side, feet stacked.
Side Plank.framing: Camera at floor level, level with her hips, so the head sits beyond the top edge of frame. No face at any point.
Side Plank.motion: She holds the side plank, hips steady and lifted. Only breathing moves.

Doorframe Row.prompt: Medium shot from behind and slightly to one side of a woman gripping both edges of an open white doorframe, arms straight, leaning her weight back with heels planted.
Doorframe Row.framing: Shot from behind at shoulder height so the back of the body fills the frame and the head is cropped at the top edge. No face, no profile.
Doorframe Row.motion: She pulls her chest toward the doorframe, drawing her shoulder blades together, then lowers back out under control. One repetition, camera locked off.

Seated Knee Lift.prompt: Side-on medium shot of a woman sitting tall on the front edge of an oak dining chair, hands resting on the seat beside her hips, spine long, feet flat.
Seated Knee Lift.motion: She lifts one knee toward her chest, lowers it under control, then lifts the other. Two slow repetitions, camera locked off.
